title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy fires his military chief after protests and names a new one
script: A new headline is now getting attention across the news cycle. The key update now being reported is: Ukraine's Zelenskyy fires his military chief after protests and names a new one. In simple words, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy fired Gen. Oleksandr Syrskyi as commander-in-chief of Ukraine's armed forces following days of protests demanding his removal. Zelenskyy appointed Mykhailo Drapatyi as the new. Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update.
